cards.text: Mud Witch

meta.brief: Plan a ~60-second documentary about how Viviana turned her pottery into Mud Witch and why she values pottery.
meta.guidance:
Cold open on Viviana naming her mugs, "this is the Chubby Mug, this is the Venus mug," over the mugs themselves. Then she introduces herself and Mud Witch. The origin: she was learning ceramics at the same time she was learning about body positivity. Her first pieces were raw clay in the range of skin tones, "so they were like naked," until she decided to "clothe these babes" with color. Then why pottery matters: physical objects are a way of connecting, and you can feel where the artist's hands have been. Her challenge to the buyer is "why is it 50 bucks? do you need ten more mugs?" End warm on "now I just want to make something that makes people smile," then the Mud Witch text box. About 50 seconds of dialogue, with room for B-roll to breathe. Music: calm_reflective.

Must open cold on "this is the Chubby Mug, this is the Venus mug" over B-roll of the chubby pastel mugs on a shelf, with no music under it.
Viviana's self-introduction must come directly after the cold open, and calm_reflective must begin on that cut.
"So they were like naked" must be covered with B-roll of the unglazed bisque pots stacked on the shelves.
"Let's clothe these babes" must come right after "so they were like naked" and be covered with B-roll of her painting color onto a piece.
The last spoken line must be "I just want to make something that makes people smile", followed directly by the text box.
